attempts.clickFirst: selected via left-click at 602,493 (47ms before right-click)

after.state: 3 nodes, all 3 right-clicks fired contextmenu but no menu appeared

interpretation.observed: TapNow canvas **completely suppresses the default right-click context menu** for all node types (text, video, command) AND for empty canvas areas. The browser's contextmenu event fires but no UI appears.
interpretation.v1_correction: V1 §9.1 §10.5 §10.6 §11.4 documented various 'node right-click' behaviors. V3 confirms: **right-click has no UI affordance** in TapNow. Selection and node operations are bound to: (1) left-click select (2) bottom floating action bar (V2 §10.8) for the 2-button node action (3) drag for move (4) keyboard for some operations.
interpretation.v2_confirmation: V2 §11.4 was correct: no React Flow context menu observed. V3 deepens this with 3 node types tested.
interpretation.css_evidence: Browser's default context menu is suppressed by an event listener that calls preventDefault() OR React Flow + TapNow doesn't bind onContextMenu handler. The contextmenu event still fires (so allowDefault is true), but the menu simply isn't rendered.
interpretation.tapnow_design_choice: Right-click is intentionally dead. TapNow uses (1) bottom floating action bar (2) Pin button (3) + handle (4) chip-based hero. **No context menu anywhere in the canvas UI**.
